About Outreach
 
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.  


About the Team  
The Customer Advocacy team you would lead is part of the broader Corporate Marketing team, which is focused on driving awareness, credibility, and presence among customers, prospects, partners, analysts, and influencers. This dynamic team is comprised of many functions, including communications, customer advocacy, and analyst relations. We serve different roles, but we all work together to amplify the Outreach brand. 
The Role 
At Outreach, our customers are our best advocates and most important asset. Do you love getting to know customers, what matters to them, and creating impactful programs that amplify their voice? We're looking for a dynamic Customer Advocacy Manager to join our corporate marketing team and drive advocacy throughout our customer base. 
This is a high-impact, highly cross-functional role where you'll blend creative storytelling, relationship building, and strategic program design to drive measurable business outcomes. In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of our customer advocacy and reference program. Partnering with sales, marketing, customer success, and product teams, you will identify, curate, and amplify impactful customer experiences that elevate both our customers and our brand. 
AI is changing how customer stories get found, shaped, and shared, and this role sits right at that intersection. We're a marketing team that uses AI to match the right advocate to the right moment, turn customer conversations into publishable stories faster, and spend more of our time on the relationships that make advocacy work. We're looking for someone who brings that same instinct to the program. 
 
Location: We’re open to remote within the US or hybrid at one of our office locations (Seattle, Atlanta).

This is a senior leadership position for someone who combines deep technical expertise in knowledge representation, graph-based learning, and reasoning systems with the ability to build, inspire, and scale a high-performing team.  

You will own the end-to-end technical direction of a per-tenant contextual knowledge graph that captures the full complexity of each customer's sales environment: accounts, deals, contacts, rep behaviors, competitive landscape, and the signals buried in calls, emails, and CRM activity. This graph is the reasoning backbone of the platform, powering next-best-action recommendations, deal risk signals, coaching suggestions, competitive intelligence, and agentic AI workflows. lists.content:
• Technical Vision & Strategy: Define and own the multi-year technical roadmap for Outreach's Knowledge Graph platform, including entity resolution, temporal reasoning, graph-based learning, and contextual inference. Translate business objectives into a coherent applied science strategy that balances research ambition with production delivery.
  • Team Leadership: Build, hire, and lead a team of applied scientists and research engineers. Establish team culture, research rigor, career development frameworks, and a high bar for both scientific quality and production impact. Mentor senior ICs into technical leaders.
  • Knowledge Graph Architecture: Drive the design of per-tenant knowledge graph schemas, ontologies, and data models tailored to the sales execution domain. Own decisions on graph databases, query languages, storage engines, and tenant isolation strategies at scale.
  • Information Extraction at Scale: Oversee pipelines that extract structured knowledge from unstructured conversational and document data (sales calls, emails, CRM notes), including coreference resolution, relation extraction, event detection, and entity linking.
  • Reasoning & Inference Systems: Lead the development of reasoning and inference layers over the knowledge graph to power next-best-action suggestions, deal risk scoring, coaching recommendations, competitive intelligence, and agentic AI decision-making.
  • Representation Learning & Graph ML: Direct research into graph-based models (GNNs, relational embeddings, link prediction, temporal graph networks) over heterogeneous, multi-relational graph structures to support downstream reasoning, retrieval, and recommendation tasks.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Partner with leaders in Engineering, Product, Design, and Data to align science investments with product priorities. Represent the applied science function in executive reviews, roadmap planning, and technical design reviews.
  • Research-to-Production Pipeline: Establish processes and infrastructure for moving from research exploration to production deployment: experiment tracking, model evaluation frameworks, A/B testing, and continuous model improvement loops.
  • Industry & Academic Engagement: Keep the team at the frontier of knowledge graph research. Foster connections with the academic community through conference participation, publications, and strategic academic partnerships. 

    •

• PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field with a focus on knowledge representation and reasoning, graph neural networks, information extraction, recommender systems or conversational AI and dialogue systems
  • 10+ years of experience in applied science or machine learning, with at least 3 years in a people leadership role managing teams of 5+ applied scientists or research engineers.
  • Demonstrated track record of building and shipping knowledge graph, NLP, or graph ML systems at production scale: not just publishing papers, but delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in at least three of: knowledge graph construction, entity resolution, information extraction, graph neural networks, temporal reasoning, representation learning, or recommender systems.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals. You can write production-quality code, not just prototype notebooks. Proficiency in Python / Golang; and graph databases or query languages (e.g., Neo4j, SPARQL, Cypher) is required.
  • Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top applied science talent. You have grown ICs into senior technical leaders and built teams with a strong shipping culture.
  • Executive communication skills. You can translate complex research concepts into business impact narratives for C-suite and board audiences.
  • Comfort with deep ambiguity. You will define the problem space, not just solve well-scoped problems. You thrive when chartering new technical directions from scratch.
  • Strong Ownership: Take end-to-end responsibility for research and model development initiatives, from problem formulation and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring, driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

• Experience building multi-tenant knowledge graph systems with per-customer isolation and scale requirements.
  • Background in sales, revenue, or B2B SaaS domains: understanding of deal cycles, pipeline management, and CRM data models.
  • Experience integrating knowledge graphs with LLM-based systems (RAG architectures, tool-augmented generation, agentic frameworks).
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate research concepts into product impact for cross-functional audiences.
  • Publications in top-tier venues (KDD, NeurIPS, ACL, EMNLP, ICLR, WWW, SIGIR, etc.) in knowledge graphs, NLP, or graph learning.
  • Experience with graph databases at scale (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or similar) including performance tuning, query optimization, and multi-region deployment.
  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-tool integration patterns.
  • Track record of building applied science teams from scratch (0→1 team formation).

• Foundational Leadership: You will define how Outreach thinks about knowledge representation and contextual reasoning, decisions that shape the platform for years. This is not an optimization role; it is a charter-defining one.
  • Greenfield Architecture: Build the knowledge graph platform from the ground up with the latitude to make foundational technical decisions on schema design, graph infrastructure, and reasoning systems.
  • Scale & Impact: Outreach processes millions of sales interactions across 4,000+ enterprise customers. Your team's work will directly power agentic AI workflows that change how revenue teams operate globally.
  • Executive Visibility: Direct exposure to top leadership in the company. Present research direction and results at the executive level.
  • World-Class Team: Join a culture that values scientific rigor, engineering excellence, and intellectual honesty. Collaborate with senior engineers, product leaders, and data scientists who care deeply about getting it right.
  • Growth into executive level: For the right leader, this role is a path to executive level as the function scales. You will shape not just the technology but the organizational structure of applied science at Outreach.

You will work across the Outreach platform to deeply understand the product direction and roadmap, then evangelize it across GTM teams and customers. You will evaluate the market, competition and partners, identify what the next opportunities to expand TAM and inform product strategy to capture that TAM.

Shaping Strategy:
  • Work closely with CPO and product line leaders, translating market reality into actionable product context and accelerating the evolution into an end-to-end agentic revenue platform.
  • Track the market and competitive landscape and customer feedback, translating that into Outreach positioning and roadmap priorities
  • Work with technology partners to inform partner strategies to expand offerings - co-sell, resell or OEM.
  • Guide pricing and packaging decisions, with evolving pricing models for AI-native products
    • Evangelizing the Product:
  • Own QBR content and field-facing product updates — presenting with depth and conviction
  • Serve as the trusted product expert in customer conversations and strategic sales cycles
  • Build and maintain crisp, business-oriented product collateral: positioning decks, competitive battlecards, release narratives, and roadmap presentations
  • Support analyst relations, investor materials, and board-level content across the platform
  • Present roadmap and demo new capabilities at marquee events - including Customer Advisory Boards and industry conferences
    • Enabling GTM:
  • Partner with Sales Enablement and Product Marketing to ensure releases land compellingly across the field
  • Work with PS/CS teams to get feedback from pilot customers to inform product roadmap, and drive AI consumption across the platform

• 8+ years in strategy consulting, product management or sales strategy in B2B SaaS
  • Ability and desire to dig into new technologies and develop disruptive strategies.
  • Market research, qualitative and quantitative, experience leading projects.
  • Proven track record presenting product overviews and strategy to executive audiences — QBRs, EBCs, SKOs, or equivalent
  • Experience with AI tools for Sales or GTM; knowledge of Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, or Gong is a strong plus
  • Exceptional communicator — able to make a complex roadmap land clearly with Sales leaders; low-ego and disciplined collaborator across a distributed team

• Background in sales enablement, pre-sales, or revenue operations alongside product experience
  • Prior experience at a company navigating a platform transition
  • MBA a plus

The Team 
Outreach is the agentic revenue platform built for modern go-to-market teams. We help revenue organizations run their entire sales motion, from first touch to closed deal to post sales, inside a single platform that goes beyond insights and delivers actions to sellers to move deals and revenue forward.

Outreach captures that signal and turns it into action: real-time coaching for reps, automatic follow-ups, and the deal and pipeline intelligence leaders need to know where to focus, what to fix, and how to improve. Reps close more. Leaders lead better. The conversation is where it starts.

This leader will own product strategy and execution across conversation intelligence, voice, meeting intelligence, and dialing. The mission is to transform every customer conversation into agentic action: coaching reps in the moment, accelerating deals, and giving leaders a clear, data-driven view of where to invest their time and how to improve their team performance and sales strategy. 
This role sits at the intersection of AI and data, voice and video, to deliver real-time coaching and actions. It requires a sharp point of view on both seller and sales leadership personas, and a track record of building product that changes how teams work, not just how they report.

  • Demonstrated experience driving software or platform adoption and leading change management with sellers and frontline sales managers

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to influence VP/C-level stakeholders on AI GTM strategy and organisational change, not just product usage

  • Comfort working with AI/agent-based products and translating technical capability into business outcomes for non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience managing enterprise customer relationships

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and translate into action

  • Proven track record of driving renewals, expansion, and customer outcomes

  • Strategic thinking and consultative problem-solving mindset

    • Preferred Qualifications (AI-Focused)

  • Experience working with AI/ML-powered products or automation tools

  • Familiarity with concepts like predictive analytics, generative AI, or workflow automation

  • Working knowledge of core GTM workflows — inbound and outbound prospecting, pipeline management, retain/expand motions, forecasting, and manager coaching cadences — along with familiarity operating alongside the personas who own them (CROs, VPs of Sales, frontline sales managers, RevOps, and CSMs)

  • Working knowledge of how to create prompts and consistent use of tools like Claude, Gemini, etc.

  • Experience using platforms like Salesforce, Gainsight, or Outreach

  • Curiosity and adaptability in a fast-evolving AI landscape

  • Risk management and mitigation planning experience

About the Team

Our AI Advisors are where the promise of the platform becomes real for our customers. We act as trusted advisors — to our customers and to each other — partnering across Sales, Product, Marketing, and Professional Services as one team working towards the same outcome: customers who see measurable value and keep coming back for more. AI is part of how we get there — sharpening the insights we bring to every customer conversation. We lead with a customer-first mindset, take ownership of the results we commit to, and bring the curiosity to keep learning as the way our customers' work continues to evolve.

The Role

We're looking for a strategic, data-driven Senior GTM AI Advisor to partner with customers in maximising value from our platform — leveraging AI to drive efficiency, adoption, and business outcomes. This role blends traditional CSM responsibilities with a strong focus on AI enablement, insights, and automation. AI is transforming how our customers operate, and this role makes sure they adopt it while they realise its full value, moving from manual processes to intelligent, automated workflows that drive real business impact.

Success in this role shows up in the numbers our customers and Outreach both care about; Net Revenue Retention, Gross Retention, and AI feature adoption; because when customers realise value, growth follows.

Location: 2 days/week in the London office is required for this position.  No relocation can be offered at this time.
